authentication.password_hash: Django Argon2id preferred; PBKDF2-SHA256 accepted migration fallback
authentication.rotation: signing keys carry a non-secret key id; verify active and retiring keys; new tokens use active key only
authentication.revocation: server-side session id is checked on every authenticated request
authentication.browser_storage: HttpOnly Secure SameSite=Lax cookie at the same-origin boundary; never localStorage

privacy.data_minimization: collect only identity, learning evidence, security audit and content provenance required by documented product behavior
privacy.deletion: scheduled deletion requires legal/owner confirmation and immutable deletion audit; user learning history follows an approved erasure/export workflow
privacy.log_redaction: passwords, tokens, cookies, authorization headers and secrets are always redacted

uploads.policy: quarantine until a scanner returns clean evidence bound to the exact SHA-256; timeout, error or missing evidence rejects commit

backup.success: restore into isolated environment, verify manifest, migrations, row counts and critical read path

stage26: select secret manager and malware scanner
stage27: calibrate limits from observed abuse and false-positive evidence
